core_style.default_register: casual — often uses humor to deflect seriousness
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — frequently elaborates on thoughts with additional clauses
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to jump between topics and ideas
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more serious tone when discussing personal stakes or emotional matters

humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — often sets up a serious moment only to undercut it with a joke

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames situations or people with humorous or sarcastic nicknames, revealing his need for control and levity in serious contexts
speech_signature.armor_off_register: shorter, more direct sentences — becomes blunt and straightforward when vulnerable

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: engineering and technology — reflects his expertise and confidence in his abilities
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and interruptions to convey thought processes

worldview.intelligence is paramount: demonstrates this through his constant need to assert his genius and question others' knowledge
worldview.personal connections matter: revealed in his interactions with Pepper and his daughter, showing he values relationships despite his bravado

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I am a genius and a hero, always in control of my destiny
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often feels overwhelmed by the consequences of his actions and the weight of responsibility
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: deflects with humor or sarcasm when confronted with his failures or vulnerabilities

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and sarcasm, often making light of serious situations
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes clipped and urgent, revealing his anxiety
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often devoid of humor
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confident, assertive speech with a commanding presence

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: uses banter to stall or deflect, but if that fails, he resorts to tactical thinking
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and wit, asserting his own perspective
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes serious and focused, often taking charge of the situation
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or doubles down on his stance rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, escalates to sarcasm, then becomes serious if the situation demands it — triggered by the stakes of the conversation

relationship_matrix.Pepper: emotional support and romantic partner — seeks her approval and connection

relationship_matrix.Bruce Banner: collaborative relationship — admires his intellect but often teases him

ignorant: emotional intelligence — struggles to navigate personal relationships effectively

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a brilliant leader and hero
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: viewed as a complex figure, both admired and criticized for his ego and decisions
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-perception as a hero and the reality of his flaws creates internal conflict
